40017551.author: पदार्थः
40017551.content: घोरे fierce, वीरजनक्ष्ये destruction of heroes, तस्मिन् in that, सङ्कुले combat, प्रवृत्ते ongoing,अङ्गदः Angada, रणोत्सुकः eager to fight, वीरम् gallant, कम्पनम् Kampana, आससाद assailed.

40017551.author: Translation
40017551.content: While the fierce fight brought destruction of heroes in the ongoing combat, Angada eager to fight, assailed gallant Kampana.

40017552.author: पदार्थः
40017552.content: सःकम्पनः that Kampana, अङ्गदम् at Angada, आहूय challenging, पूर्वम् in anticipation, गदया mace, वेगितः swiftly, कोपात् in anger, ताडयामास hurled, भृशाहतः grievously hurt, सः he, चचाल reeled.

40017552.author: Translation
40017552.content: Kampana struck Angada challenging himin anticipation. He swiftly hurled a mace in anger and hurt him grievously and Angada reeled.

40017553.author: पदार्थः
40017553.content: तेजस्वी rejuvenated, सः he, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्राप्य acquired, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् peak, चिक्षेप shattered, कम्पनः Kampana, प्रहारेण blow, अर्दितः wounded, भुवि ground, पतितः fell.

40017553.author: Translation
40017553.content: Rejuvenated Angada, after gaining consciousness acquired a mountain peak and shattered Kampana with a blow. wounded Kampana fell down.

40017554.author: पदार्थः
40017554.content: ततः then, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, रणे in war, हतम् killed, कम्पनम् Kampana, दृष्टवा seeing, तत्र there, अबीतवत् fearless hero, रथेन by chariot, अङ्गदम् to Angada, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अभ्यपतत् reached.

40017554.author: Translation
40017554.content: Then seeing Kampana killed, Sonitaksha, a fearless hero, quickly reached Angada by chariot.

40017555.author: पदार्थः
40017555.content: सः he, वेगितः swiftly, शरीरदारणैः piercing shafts, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध struck, क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैः known as Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, वत्सदन्सैः Vatsadanta, शिलीमुखैः Silimukha, कर्णिशल्यविपादैःच Karni, Salya, Vipada, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिश्च many, शरैः arrows.

40017555.author: Translation
40017555.content: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.

40017556.author: पदार्थः
40017556.content: सः he, वेगितः swiftly, शरीरदारणैः piercing shafts, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध struck, क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैः known as Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, वत्सदन्सैः Vatsadanta, शिलीमुखैः Silimukha, कर्णिशल्यविपादैःच Karni, Salya, Vipada, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिश्च many, शरैः arrows.

40017556.author: Translation
40017556.content: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.

40017557.author: पदार्थः
40017557.content: प्रतिविद्धाङ्गः encountered, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, प्रतापवान् courageous, बली mighty, अङ्गदः Angada, उग्रम् formidable, धनुः bow, रथम् chariot, बाणान् arrows, तरसा vigour, ममर्द crumbled.

40017557.author: Translation
40017557.content: Courageous son of Vali, the mighty Angada encountered with vigour and crumbled the formidable bow (of Sonitaksha), his chariot and arrows.

40017558.author: पदार्थः
40017558.content: ततः there upon, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, क्षिप्रम् quickly, असिचर्म sword, समाददे shield, दिवम् to the sky, क्रुद्धः enraged, वेगवान् at high speed, अविचारयन् unhesitatingly, उत्पपात sprang up.

40017558.author: Translation
40017558.content: Thereupon enraged Sonitaksha, quickly sprang up to the sky at high speed with sword and shield.

40017559.author: पदार्थः
40017559.content: बली mighty, अङ्गदः Angada, क्षिप्रतरम् at a higher speed, आफ्लुत्य springing up, तम् him, परामृश्य grasped, करेण by hand, तस्य his, खङ्गम् sword, आच्छिद्य irritated, ननाद च making loud noise.

40017559.author: Translation
40017559.content: Mighty Angada springing up at a higher speed grasped his (Sonitaksha) hand and irritated him with a sword making loud noise.

40017560.author: पदार्थः
40017560.content: ततः then, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, अंसफलके fl at surface, खडगम् sword, निजघान pierced, कपिकुञ्जरः monkey leader, एनम् in that way, यज्ञोपवतवत् diagonally, चिच्छेद cut him.

40017560.author: Translation
40017560.content: Then Angada pierced his sword on the fl at surface of his shoulder diagonally and cut him with his sword.

40017561.author: पदार्थः
40017561.content: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, तंमहाखडगम् that great sword, प्रगृह्य seizing, पुनःपुनः again and again, विनद्य च roaring, परीन् to final termination, अरीन् enemy, रणशीर्षे left over in the fight, अभिदुद्राव went forward.

40017561.author: Translation
40017561.content: Vali's son, seizing that great sword again and again, roaring to finally terminate the remaining Rakshasas, went forward.

40017562.author: पदार्थः
40017562.content: वीरः hero, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, सः he, शोणिताः Sonitha, समाविध्य recovering, आयसीम् iron, गदाम् mace, प्रगृह्य taking hold, तमेव with that, अनुपपात ह rushed behind.

40017562.author: Translation
40017562.content: Sonitha adorned with golden armlets taking hold of iron mace rushed behind Angada.

40017563.author: पदार्थः
40017563.content: ततः then, वीरः hero, बली mighty, यूपाक्षस्तु Yupaksha also, प्रजङ्घसहितः Prajagna for his part, क्रुद्धः angry, महाबलम् mighty, वालिपुत्रम् Angada, रथेन chariot, अभिययौ assailed.

40017563.author: Translation
40017563.content: Then mighty Yupaksha, and Prajaghna for his part in fury assailed mighty Angada's chariot.

40017564.author: पदार्थः
40017564.content: तयोः both of them, शोणिताक्षप्रजङ्घयोः Sonitaksha and Prajaghna, मध्ये midst, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of monkeys, विशाखयोः Visakha, मध्यगतः coming in between, पूर्णचन्द्रःइव like full moon, आभवत् shone.

40017564.author: Translation
40017564.content: Angada, the foremost of Vanaras, coming between both Sonitaksha and Prajaghna shone like a full moon between the Visakha stars.

40017565.author: पदार्थः
40017565.content: मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदःएव even Dwivida, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिरक्षन्तौ for protection, परस्परदीदृक्ष्या one another to hold in check, तस्य his, अभ्याशे facing the enemy, तस्थतुः took position.

40017565.author: Translation
40017565.content: Both Mainda and Dwivida (maternal uncles of Angada) took position for the protection of one another facing the enemy.

40017566.author: पदार्थः
40017566.content: महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः stupendous strength, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, प्रतियत्ताः vigilant, असिचर्मगदाधराः wielding sword and mace, रोषात् agitated, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिषेतुः assailed.

40017566.author: Translation
40017566.content: Rakshasas wielding swords and mace, endowed with stupendous strength and of huge body agitated and assailed Vanaras.

40017567.author: पदार्थः
40017567.content: त्रिभिः three, राक्षसपुङ्गवैः Rakshasa leaders, संसक्तानाम् momentous, त्रयाणाम् with the three, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara chiefs, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, महत् momentous, युद्धम् war, अभवत् took place.

40017567.author: Translation
40017567.content: A momentous war took place between the three Rakshasas (Prajaghna, Yupaksha and Sonitaksha) and Vanara chiefs (Angada, Dwivida and Mainda) that caused horripilation.

40017568.author: पदार्थः
40017568.content: आहवे in the combat, ते they, वृक्षान् trees, समादाय taking, सम्प्रचिक्षिपुः at that time shattered, महाबलः mighty, प्रजङ्घः Prajaghana, खडगेन with sword, तान् them, प्रतिचिच्छेद violently hurled.

40017568.author: Translation
40017568.content: In the comb at the Vanaras seizing hold of trees hurled violently and mighty Prajaghna with his sword shattered them

40017569.author: पदार्थः
40017569.content: आहवे in that war, रथान् chariots, अश्वान् horses, द्रुमान् trees, शैलान् rocks, प्रतिचिक्षिपुः encountered, निशाचरः night rangers, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, तान् them, शरौघैः tore them चिच्छेद , shattered.

40017569.author: Translation
40017569.content: In that war the Vanaras hurled trees, rocks on chariots and horses and Yupaksha encountered them and tore them.

40017570.author: पदार्थः
40017570.content: वीर्यवान् heroic, प्रतापवान् courageous, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, द्विविदमैन्दाभ्याम् with Dwivida and Mainda, उत्पाट्य hurled, सृष्टान् tearing, द्रुमान् trees, गदया by mace, मध्ये midway, बभञ्ज crushed.

40017570.author: Translation
40017570.content: Heroic and courageous Sonitaksha tore the trees hurled by Dwivida and Mainda in midway by his mace and crushed them.

40017571.author: पदार्थः
40017571.content: प्रजङ्घः Prajaghna, परमर्मनिकृन्तनम् that which can pierce into private parts, विपुलम् huge, खडगम् sword, उद्यम्य taking up, वेगितः swiftly, वालिपुत्राय Angada's, अभिदुद्राव went forward and assailed.

40017571.author: Translation
40017571.content: Prajaghna taking up a huge sword went forward swiftly and assailed Angada.

40017572.author: पदार्थः
40017572.content: तदा then, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary strength, अतिबलः of stupendous power, वानरेन्द्रः Vanara leader, अभ्याशगतम् coming forward, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, अश्वकर्णेव Aswakarna, द्रुमेण tree, आजघान hit him.

40017572.author: Translation
40017572.content: Then Vanara leader Angada who was endowed with extraordinary strength, seeing Prajaghna of stupendous power coming forward, hit him with Aswakarna tree.

40017573.author: पदार्थः
40017573.content: सः he, Angada, अस्य his, सनिस्त्रिंशम् which held the sword, बाहुम् shoulders, मुष्टिना with his fist, आजघान hit him, वालिपुत्रस्य Angada, घातेन by the blow, सःअसिः that sword, क्षितौ broken, पपात fell.

40017573.author: Translation
40017573.content: Angada hit the shoulder of Prajaghna which held the sword, with his fist. By that blow the sword got broken and dropped down

40017574.author: पदार्थः
40017574.content: भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, मुलसन्निभम् pestle shape, तंखङ्गम् that sword, दृष्टवा seeing, महाबलः mighty, वज्रकल्पम् hard as thunderbolt, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched.

40017574.author: Translation
40017574.content: Seeing the pestle shaped sword fallen on the ground, mighty Prajaghna clenched his fist, which was as hard as the thunderbolt.

40017575.author: पदार्थः
40017575.content: महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, सः he, Sonitaksha, महावीर्यम् highly valiant, वानरर्षभम् Vanara bull, अङ्गदम् Angada, ललाटे forehead, आजघान hit, सः he, मुहर्तम् for a while, चचाल ह unable to move.

40017575.author: Translation
40017575.content: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.

40017576.author: पदार्थः
40017576.content: तेजस्वी full of vigour, प्रतापवान् courageous, सः he, वालिपुत्र Vali's son, संज्ञाम् regaining, प्राप्य hit, खङ्गेना by the sword, प्रजङ्घस्य Prajaghna's, शिरः head, कायात् his trunk, पातयत्क्षितौ made to fall down.

40017576.author: Translation
40017576.content: Son of Vali, who was full of vigour, on regaining consciousness hit Prajaghna on the head and trunk and made him fall down.

40017577.author: पदार्थः
40017577.content: रणे in fight, पितृव्ये uncle, निहते fallen hurt, सः he, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, अश्रुपूर्णाक्षः eyes filled with tears, क्षीणेषुः exhausted, क्षिप्रम् instantly, रथात् chariot, अवरुह्य alighting, खङ्गम् sword, आददे wielded.

40017577.author: Translation
40017577.content: Instantly alighting from the chariot, Yupaksha seeing the uncle exhausted and hurt, eyes filled with tears, he wielded the sword.

40017578.author: पदार्थः
40017578.content: द्विविदः Dwivida, त्वरन् quickly, आपतन्तम् fallen, तंयूपाक्षम् Yupakasha, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, क्रुद्धः furious, उरसि bosom, आजघान marched, बली , बलात् with force, जग्राह caught.

40017578.author: Translation
40017578.content: Observing Yupakasha fallen and rushing quickly, furious Dwivida struck him in the bosom with force and caught him

40017579.author: पदार्थः
40017579.content: ततः then, गदाग्रेण with the mace, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, महाबलम् of great strength, भ्रातरम् brother, गृहीतम् being caught, दृष्टवा seeing, द्विविदम् Dwivida, वक्षसि from the bosom, आजघान struck.

40017579.author: Translation
40017579.content: Then seeing the brother caught, mighty Sonitaksha struck Dwivida in the bosom by a mace.

40017580.author: पदार्थः
40017580.content: गदा mace, तेन by that, अभिहतः reeled, महाबलः mighty, सःद्विविदः that Dwivida, सञ्चचाल not move, पुनः again, उद्यताम् uplifted, तस्य his, गदाम् mace, जहार snatched.

40017580.author: Translation
40017580.content: Dwivida, though mighty reeled and could not move when struck by Sonitaksha. He got up and again and snatched the mace from Sonithaksha.

40017581.author: पदार्थः
40017581.content: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meantime मैन्दः Mainda, वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, वीरः hero, आगमत् arrived, वीर्यवान् valiant, तलेन by palm, यूपाक्षम् Yupaksha, उरसि chest, ताडयामास struck.

40017581.author: Translation
40017581.content: In the meantime, valiant Vanara leader Mainda arrived and struck with his palm on the chest of Yupaksha.

40017582.author: पदार्थः
40017582.content: समरे in that fight, तौ the two, तरस्विनौ courageous, शोणिताक्ष्यूपाक्षौ Sonitaksha and Yupaksha, प्लवङ्गाभ्याम् monkeys, भृशम् violently, तीव्रम् intense, आकर्षोत्पाटनम् one another pulling and over throwing, चक्रतुः contested.

40017582.author: Translation
40017582.content: In that fight, courageous Sonitaksha and Yupaksha contested with the two monkeys pulling one another violently and throwing intensely.

40017583.author: पदार्थः
40017583.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, द्विविदः Dwivida, नखैः nails, शोणिताक्षम् Sonitaksha, मुखे face, विददार tearing, वेगेन quickening his pace, क्षितौ on the surface of the ground, आविध्य thrown with force, निष्पिपेष च bruising.

40017583.author: Translation
40017583.content: Valiant Dwivida, for his part, tore Sonitaksha on his face with his nails, and quickening his pace threw him on the surface of the ground and bruised him.

40017584.author: पदार्थः
40017584.content: वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, मैन्दः Mainda, अभिसङ्कृद्धः getting very angry, यूपाक्षम् Yupaksha, बाहुभ्याम् many times, पीडयामास pierced, सः he, हतः dead, क्षितौ on the ground, पपात fell.

40017584.author: Translation
40017584.content: Vanara leader, Mainda on his part, angrily pierced Yupaksha many times who fell on the ground dead.

40017585.author: पदार्थः
40017585.content: तदा then, हतप्रवीरा heroes dead, सा many, राक्षसेन्द्रचमूः Rakshasa king's army, व्यथिता distressed, कुम्भकर्णसुतः son of Kumbhakarna, यतः like that, अभिमुखी went towards, जगाम went.

40017585.author: Translation
40017585.content: Then many heroes died, Rakshasa king's army was distressed and went towards where Kumbhakarna's son was fighting.

40017586.author: पदार्थः
40017586.content: कुम्भः Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, आपतन्तीम् restored confidence, तांचमूम् of the troops, सान्त्वयत् , अथ and then, तेजस्वी energetic, कुम्भः Kumbha, महावीर्यैः great hero, लब्धलक्षैः favourable opportunity, प्लवंगमैः monkeys, निपातितमहावीराम् eminent heroes struck down, रक्षश्चमूम् of Rakshasa army, दृष्टवा seeing, ततः then, रणे in the battlefield, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, अथोत्कष्टम् drawn up excellent, कर्म task, चक्रे performed.

40017586.author: Translation
40017586.content: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.

40017587.author: पदार्थः
40017587.content: कुम्भः Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, आपतन्तीम् restored confidence, तांचमूम् of the troops, सान्त्वयत् , अथ and then, तेजस्वी energetic, कुम्भः Kumbha, महावीर्यैः great hero, लब्धलक्षैः favourable opportunity, प्लवंगमैः monkeys, निपातितमहावीराम् eminent heroes struck down, रक्षश्चमूम् of Rakshasa army, दृष्टवा seeing, ततः then, रणे in the battlefield, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, अथोत्कष्टम् drawn up excellent, कर्म task, चक्रे performed.

40017587.author: Translation
40017587.content: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.

40017588.author: पदार्थः
40017588.content: धन्विनाम् wielder of bow, श्रेष्ठः foremost, सः he, धनुः bow, प्रगृह्य taking, सुसमाहितः fully composed, आशीविषप्रख्यान् resembling poisonous serpents, देहविदारणान् capable of tearing the body, शरान् arrows, मुमोच released.

40017588.author: Translation
40017588.content: He (Kumbha), the foremost wielder of bow, taking up the bow, remaining fully composed released arrows that resembled poisonous serpents capable of tearing the flesh.

40017589.author: पदार्थः
40017589.content: सशरम् those arrows, उत्तमम् best, तस्य his, तत् that, धनुः bow, विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्मत् shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुः second bow of Indra यथा like that, भूयः shone, शुशुभे released.

40017589.author: Translation
40017589.content: Those best arrows fixed to the bow were shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, and like a second bow of Indra.

40017590.author: पदार्थः
40017590.content: तदा then, आकर्णाकृष्टमुक्तेन stretched till the ear and released, हाटकपुङ्खेन fixed with wings, पत्त्रवाससा arrow loosened to kill, तेन by that, पत्रतिणा golden shafted arrow, द्विविदम् Dwivida, जघान struck.

40017590.author: Translation
40017590.content: Then he struck Dwivida with a golden shafted arrow that was loosened to kill by stretching the bow till the ear and released.

40017591.author: पदार्थः
40017591.content: तेन by that, सहसा sudden, अभिहतः struck, त्रिकूटाभः Trikuta, प्लवगोत्तमः foremost of Vanara, विह्वलन् alarmed, वप्रमुक्तपदः legs outstretched, स्फुरन् trembling, निपपात fell.

40017591.author: Translation
40017591.content: Struck all of a sudden, the foremost Vanara (Dwivida) alarmed, fell with legs, outstretched, trembling.

40017592.author: पदार्थः
40017592.content: मैन्दःतु Maindaaslo, तत्र there, महाहवे great comb at भग्नम् shattered, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, महतीम् huge, शिलाम् rock, प्रगृह्य taking, वेगेन swiftly, अभिदुद्राव rushed.

40017592.author: Translation
40017592.content: Seeing the brother shattered in the great combat, Mainda on his part seizing a huge rock rushed swiftly.

40017593.author: पदार्थः
40017593.content: महाबलः mighty, ताम् him, शिलाम् rock, राक्षसाय Rakshasa, प्रचिक्षेप hurled to crush, कुम्भः Kumbha, प्रसन्नैः sharp, पञ्चभिः five, शरैः arrows, तांशिलाम् that rock, बिभेद broken.

40017593.author: Translation
40017593.content: The mighty Vanara (Mainda) for his part hurled the rock to crush the Rakshasa. Kumbha attacked him with five sharp arrows and rock got broken.

40017594.author: पदार्थः
40017594.content: महातेजाः haughty, सुमुख arrow म् charming, आशीविषोपमम् resembling venomous serpent, अन्यम् another, शरम् arrow, सन्धाय fixing, द्विविदाग्रजम् Dwivida's brother, वक्षसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

40017594.author: Translation
40017594.content: Haughty Kumbha, fixed a charming arrow resembling a venomous serpent and struck at Dwivida's brother.

40017595.author: पदार्थः
40017595.content: वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, सःमैन्दः that Mainda, तेन by that, प्रहरेण blow, तेन his, मर्मणि private, अभिहतः hit, मूर्छितः lost consciousness, भुवि ground, पपात fell.

40017595.author: Translation
40017595.content: That blow hit the Vanara leader in his private parts, and Mainda lost consciousness and fell down.

40017596.author: पदार्थः
40017596.content: अङ्गदः Angada, पथितौ fallen, महाबलौ endowed with great strength, मातुलौ maternal uncle, दृष्टवा seeing, उद्यतकार्मुकम् wielding bow, कुम्भम् Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, अभिदुद्राव attacked.

40017596.author: Translation
40017596.content: Seeing the two maternal uncles fallen, Angada, who was endowed with great strength, attacked Kumbha, wielding a bow.

40017597.author: पदार्थः
40017597.content: कुम्भः Kumbha, आपतन्तम् coming towards, तम् him, पञ्चभिः five, आयसैः steel arrows, शितैः hundred, अन्यैः other, त्रिभिःबाणैः threeshafts, तोमरैः lances, मातङ्गमिव like elephant, विव्याध pierced.

40017597.author: Translation
40017597.content: Kumbha seeing Angada advancing towards him, with five steel arrows and three shafts pierced him just as an elephant is pierced with lances.

40017598.author: पदार्थः
40017598.content: सः he, वीर्यवान् valiant, कुम्भः Kumbha, अकुण्ठधारैः unobstructed, निशितैः sharp, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, विविधैः several, कनकभूषणैः gold ornaments, बाणैः arrows, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध pierced.

40017598.author: Translation
40017598.content: Kumbha, a valiant hero pierced Angada continuously with several sharp and pointed arrows decked with gold.

40017599.author: पदार्थः
40017599.content: प्रतिविद्धाङ्गः not shaken by attack, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, न कम्पते not shaken, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि forehead, शिलापादपवर्षाणि rain of rocks and trees, ववर्ष ह showered.

40017599.author: Translation
40017599.content: Vali's son was not shaken by the strike, showered rain of rocks and trees on his (Kumbha) forehead.

40017600.author: पदार्थः
40017600.content: श्रीमान् prosperous, कुम्भकर्णात्मजः Kumbhakarna's son, सः he, वालिपुत्त्रसमीरितान् rained by Vali's son, तान् those, सर्वान् all, प्रचिच्छेद shattered, शिलाःपुनः rocks and again, बिभेद च broken also.

40017600.author: Translation
40017600.content: Prosperous Kumbhakarna's son also shattered the rocks hurled on him, breaking them.

40017601.author: पदार्थः
40017601.content: कुम्भः Kumbha, आपतन्तम् coming towards, वानरयूथपम् Vanara leaders, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, उल्काभ्याम् fire sticks, कुञ्जरम् इव like elephant, बाणाभ्याम् with arrows, भ्रुवोः eyebrows, विव्याध pierced.

40017601.author: Translation
40017601.content: Kumbha observing the Vanara leader coming towards him attacked him with fire sticks and pierced his eyebrows.

40017602.author: पदार्थः
40017602.content: तस्य his, रुधिरम् blood, सुस्राव flowed, अस्य his, लोचने eyes, पिहिते च from the injury, अङ्गदः Angada, रुधिरोक्षिते eyes veiled by blood, नेत्रे eyes, पाणिना hand s, पिधाय covering, एकेन one, पाणिना hand, आसन्नम् nearby, सालम् sal tree, परिजग्राह took hold of.

40017602.author: Translation
40017602.content: Blood flowed from his injured eyes and his eyes got veiled by blood. Covering his eyes with one hand he took hold of a Sal tree nearby.

40017603.author: पदार्थः
40017603.content: सस्कन्धम् trunk, उरसि chest, सम्पीड्य compressing, करेण with hand, अभिनिवेश्य च bending forward, किञ्चित् a little, अभ्यवनम्य its branches, महारणे in the great fight, एनम् in that way, उन्ममाथ tore, यथागजः like an elephant.

40017603.author: Translation
40017603.content: Compressing the trunk of the tree on the chest with one hand and bending forward a little its branches with another hand, he (Angada) tore Kumbha in that way in the great fight like an elephant.

40017604.author: पदार्थः
40017604.content: सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, पश्यताम् seeing, इन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमम् resembling Indra's banner, मन्दरसन्निभम् like the Mandara mountain, तंवृक्षम् that tree, वेगेन hurriedly, समुत्सृजन्तम् impatiently.

40017604.author: Translation
40017604.content: All the Rakshasas seeing the tall tree, which was like Mandara mountain, resembling Indra's banner hurriedly was about to let loose.

40017605.author: पदार्थः
40017605.content: सः he, कायभेदनैः tearing the body, शितैः sharp, सप्तभिः seven, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद shattered, सः , अङ्गदः that Angada, अभीक्ष्णम् immediately, विव्यथे pained, ससादच screaming, मुमोह च lost senses.

40017605.author: Translation
40017605.content: Kumbha shattered Angada with seven sharp arrows capable of tearing the body. Angada, pained by that screamed and lost his senses.

40017606.author: पदार्थः
40017606.content: व्यथितं tormented, सीदन्तम् sinking into despondency, सागरम् इव like into an ocean, दुरासदम् difficult to encounter, अङ्गदम् Angada, दृष्टवा seeing, हरिश्रेष्ठाः foremost of monkeys, रामाय to Rama, न्यवेदयन् submitted.

40017606.author: Translation
40017606.content: Seeing the foremost Vanara, Angada who was difficult to encounter fell and like sinking into the ocean of despondency, the foremost Vanaras submitted to Rama.

40017607.author: पदार्थः
40017607.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, रणाजरे in the battlefield, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, व्यथितम् pained, श्रुत्वा hearing, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् Jambavan and other leaders, हरिश्रेष्ठान् best of monkeys, व्यादेश ordered.

40017607.author: Translation
40017607.content: On hearing that Angada was tormented in the battlefield and pained he ordered Jambavan and the best of monkey leaders to help him.

40017608.author: पदार्थः
40017608.content: ते those, वानरशार्दूलाः Vanara tigers, रामस्य Rama's, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुसङ्कृद्धाः very angry, उद्यतकार्मुकम् took up his bow, कुम्भम् Kumbha, अभिपेतुः to attack.

40017608.author: Translation
40017608.content: On hearing Rama's command, the enraged Vanara tigers took up bows to attack Kumbha.

40017609.author: पदार्थः
40017609.content: ततः then, वानरर्षभाः bull among Vanaras, द्रुमशिलाहस्ताः trees, rocks taking in hand, कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः eyes red in anger, अङ्गदम् Angada, रिरक्षिषन्तः for the protection, अभ्यपतन् started.

40017609.author: Translation
40017609.content: Bulls among Vanaras then took trees, and rocks in hand, with their eyes red in anger started for the protection of Angada.

40017610.author: पदार्थः
40017610.content: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavan and others, सुषेणश्च Sushena, वानरः Vanaras, वेगदर्शी च Vegadarsi, क्रुद्धाः angry, वीरम् hero, कुम्भकर्णात्मजम् Kumbhakarna's son, समभिदुद्रुवुः also rushed.

40017610.author: Translation
40017610.content: Jambavan, Sushena, Vegadarsi and other heroic Vanaras, full of anger also rushed to assail Kumbhakarna's son.

40017611.author: पदार्थः
40017611.content: आपततः advancing, महाबलान् great army, तान् them, वानरेन्द्रान् Vanara leaders, समीक्ष्य perceiving, जलाशयम् torrent, नगेनेव like a mountain, शरौघेण with volley of arrows, आववार obstructed.

40017611.author: Translation
40017611.content: Perceiving that great army of Vanara leaders are advancing, Kumbha obstructed them with a volley of arrows just like a mountain obstructing the path of torrent.

40017612.author: पदार्थः
40017612.content: महात्मानः great self, वानरेंद्राः Vanara leader, तस्य his, बाणपथम् range of arrows, प्राप्य reaching, महोदधिः great ocean, वेलाम् इव like tide, अतिवर्तितुम् overstep, न शेकुः become unsuccessful.

40017612.author: Translation
40017612.content: The Vanara leaders could not bear the range of arrows of Kumbhaka, just as a tide can't overstep the shore of an ocean.

40017613.author: पदार्थः
40017613.content: शरवृष्टिभि rain of arrows, अर्दितान् pained, तान् them, हरिगणान् Vanara army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवगेश्वरः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भ्रातृजम् brother's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, पृष्ठतःकृत्वा in the rear, रणे in combat, वेगवान् endowed with speed, केसरी lion, शैलसानुचरम् roaming in the mountains, नागमिव like elephant, वेगेन swiftly, कुम्भमाहवे Kumbhakarna's son, अभिदुद्राव assailed.

40017613.author: Translation
40017613.content: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

40017614.author: पदार्थः
40017614.content: शरवृष्टिभि rain of arrows, अर्दितान् pained, तान् them, हरिगणान् Vanara army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवगेश्वरः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भ्रातृजम् brother's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, पृष्ठतःकृत्वा in the rear, रणे in combat, वेगवान् endowed with speed, केसरी lion, शैलसानुचरम् roaming in the mountains, नागमिव like elephant, वेगेन swiftly, कुम्भमाहवे Kumbhakarna's son, अभिदुद्राव assailed.

40017614.author: Translation
40017614.content: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

40017615.author: पदार्थः
40017615.content: सः he, महाबलः mighty strong, अश्वकर्णान्दवान् Aswakarna, बहून् many, महाशैलान् huge trees, उत्पाट्य uprooting, विविधान् several, अन्यान् others, वृक्षान् च trees, चिक्षेप hurled them.

40017615.author: Translation
40017615.content: Mighty strong he was, uprooting Aswakarna and many other several kinds of trees he hurled at them (Rakshasas).

40017616.author: पदार्थः
40017616.content: शीघ्रं frenzied, कुम्भकर्णात्मजः Kumbhakarna's son, आकाशम् space, छादयन्तीम् covering, दुरासदाम् difficult to approach, ताम् them, वृक्षवृष्टिम् shower of trees, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, चिच्छेद torn asunder.

40017616.author: Translation
40017616.content: Frenzied Kumbhakarna's son was torn under the shower of trees that covered space with sharp arrows which was difficult to approach.

40017617.author: पदार्थः
40017617.content: अभिलक्षेण aimed at the target, तीव्रेण violently, कुम्भेन by Kumbha, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, अचितास्तेद्रुमा covered with trees, ते those, घोराः dreadful, शतघ्नयःयथा like Sataghnis, रेजुः shone.

40017617.author: Translation
40017617.content: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.

40017618.author: पदार्थः
40017618.content: वीर्यवान् valiant hero, श्रीमान् prosperous, महासत्वः very noble, वानराधिपतिः Vanara chief, कुम्भेन at Kumbha, सञ्छिन्नम् tormented, तत् that, द्रुमवर्षम् rain of trees, दृष्टवा seeing, न विव्यथे not distressed.

40017618.author: Translation
40017618.content: Valiant hero, the prosperous and noble Sugriva, the chief of Vanaras did not get distressed when tormented with rain of trees.

40017619.author: पदार्थः
40017619.content: निर्भिद्यमानः snatching, सः he, तान् them, शरान् arrows, सहमानः tolerating the pain, कुम्भस्य Kumbha's, इन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् like Indra's rainbow, धनुः bow, सहसा forcibly, आक्षिप्य pulling, बभञ्च broke.

40017619.author: Translation
40017619.content: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.

40017620.author: पदार्थः
40017620.content: ततः then, शीघ्रम् speedily, अवफ्लुत leaping, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कर्म deed, कृत्वा having done, कुपितः angry, भग्नशृङ्गम् peak broken, द्विपम् इव flame like, कुम्भम् elephant, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40017620.author: Translation
40017620.content: Then Sugriva leapt into the chariot, which was a difficult deed to perform, saw Kumbha who was like an elephant and whose tusks were broken and spoke.

40017621.author: पदार्थः
40017621.content: निकुम्भाग्रज elder brother of Nikumbha, ते your, वीर्यम् valour, बाणवेगवत् by the speed of your arrow, अद्भुतम् wonderful, सन्नतिश्च compliance, प्रभावश्च glory, तववा of yours, रावणस्यवा or Ravana's.

40017621.author: Translation
40017621.content: "Oh, elder brother of Nikumbha! Your valour, speed of your arrows, compliance, and glory is wonderful like that of Ravana's."

40017622.author: पदार्थः
40017622.content: प्रह्लादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुबेरवरुणोपम Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera, Varuna, त्वम् you, एकः alone, बलवत्ततम् equal in might, पितरम् father's, अनुजातः like father, असि are.

40017622.author: Translation
40017622.content: "You are equal to Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera and Varuna in might. You alone have taken over like your father."

40017623.author: पदार्थः
40017623.content: महाबाहुम् mighty armed, शूलहस्तम् wielding pike in hand, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, त्वाम् you, एकमेव you alone, त्रिदशाः gods, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has overcome senses, आधयः pre eminent, नातिवर्तन्ते not able to overcome, महाबुद्धे highly intelligent, विक्रमस्व prowess, मम me, कर्माणि deeds, तः those, पश्यत: exhibit.

40017623.author: Translation
40017623.content: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."

40017624.author: पदार्थः
40017624.content: महाबाहुम् mighty armed, शूलहस्तम् wielding pike in hand, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, त्वाम् you, एकमेव you alone, त्रिदशाः gods, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has overcome senses, आधयः pre eminent, नातिवर्तन्ते not able to overcome, महाबुद्धे highly intelligent, विक्रमस्व prowess, मम me, कर्माणि deeds, तः those, पश्यत: exhibit.

40017624.author: Translation
40017624.content: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."

40017625.author: पदार्थः
40017625.content: ते your, पितृव्यः uncle, वरदानात् by the boons, देवदानवान् Devas and Danavas, सहते with stand, कुम्भकर्णस्तु Kumbhakarna also, वीर्येण courage, सुरासुरान् gods and demons, सहते with stand.

40017625.author: Translation
40017625.content: "Your uncle Ravana is able to withstand the Devas and Danavas by virtue of the boons and Kumbhakarna was able to with stand gods and demons by virtue of his courage."

40017626.author: पदार्थः
40017626.content: ततः thereafter, कुम्भः Kumbha, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva's, जगृहे held, तदा then, अहतमदौ intoxicated, गजाविव like elephants, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, निश्श्वसन्तौ breathing heavily, अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ holding one another's limbs, इतरेतरम् one another, कर्षन्तौ rubbing each other, परिश्रमात् in exertion, मुखतः from face, सधूमाम् smoke, ज्वालाम् flames, विस्पजन्तौ let out.

40017626.author: Translation
40017626.content: Thereafter Kumbha held Sugriva's shoulders. They were like two intoxicated elephants holding one another's limbs and rubbing each other and breathing heavily. In exertion they let out from their face fire mixed with smoke.

40017627.author: पदार्थः
40017627.content: अद्य now, समरे in combat, मयासह with me, तव your, अद्भुतम् wonderful, महाविमर्दम् mighty encounter, शक्रम्बरयोरिव Indra and Sambara like, भूतानि beings, पश्यन्तु witness.

40017627.author: Translation
40017627.content: "Just as the wonderful conflict between Indra and Sambara let the beings witness the mighty comb at between me and you."

40017628.author: पदार्थः
40017628.content: त्वया your, अप्रतिमम् unequal, कर्म deed, कृतम् done, अस्त्रकौशलं च efficiency in the use of weapons, दर्शितम् exhibited, भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, एते of those, हरिवीराश्च monkey heroes, पातिताः made to fall.

40017628.author: Translation
40017628.content: "By an unequal deed done by you in the efficiency in the use of weapons has been exhibited. The monkey heroes of terrific valour have been made to fall."

40017629.author: पदार्थः
40017629.content: वीर stalwart, कृतकर्मपरिश्रान्तः exhausted by your deeds and resting, मया by me, उपालम्भभयात् fear of reproaching, हतः finished, नअसि are not, विश्रान्तः having rested, मे my, बलम् strength, पश्य witness.

40017629.author: Translation
40017629.content: "O Stalwart! You have not been finished by me for the fear of reproaching. You are exhausted by your deeds and resting. Having rested, witness my strength now."

40017630.author: पदार्थः
40017630.content: सावमानेन slighted, तेन by the, सुग्रीवाक्येन Sugriva's words, मानितः flattered, राज्याहुतस्य royalty captivated, अग्नेःइव like fire, तस्य his, तेजः fire of energy, अभ्यवर्धत increased.

40017630.author: Translation
40017630.content: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

40017631.author: पदार्थः
40017631.content: सावमानेन slighted, तेन by the, सुग्रीवाक्येन Sugriva's words, मानितः flattered, राज्याहुतस्य royalty captivated, अग्नेःइव like fire, तस्य his, तेजः fire of energy, अभ्यवर्धत increased.

40017631.author: Translation
40017631.content: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

40017632.author: पदार्थः
40017632.content: सावमानेन slighted, तेन by the, सुग्रीवाक्येन Sugriva's words, मानितः flattered, राज्याहुतस्य royalty captivated, अग्नेःइव like fire, तस्य his, तेजः fire of energy, अभ्यवर्धत increased.

40017632.author: Translation
40017632.content: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

40017633.author: पदार्थः
40017633.content: तयोः those two, पादाभिघातात् by the trampling of their feet, मही earth, निमग्ना sank, अभवत् down, वरुणालयः abode of Varuna (ocean), व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गः rolling waves became, चुक्षुभे agitated.

40017633.author: Translation
40017633.content: Then by the trampling of their feet the earth sank down, the abode of Varuna (ocean) was agitated with rolling waves.

40017634.author: पदार्थः
40017634.content: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कुम्भम् Kumbha, समुत्क्षिप्य threw into ocean, उदधेः lifted, तलम् bottom, दर्शयन् to show, वेगेन quickly, लवणाम्भसि into the ocean, पातयामास threw him.

40017634.author: Translation
40017634.content: Then Sugriva lifted Kumbha and threw him into the ocean quickly, to show him the bottom.

40017635.author: पदार्थः
40017635.content: ततः then, कुम्भनिपातेन by the fallen Kumbha, समुत्थितः from the ocean, जलराशिः ocean, व्निध्यमन्दरसङ्काशः form of Vindhya and Mandara, समन्ततः all over, विससर्प flowed.

40017635.author: Translation
40017635.content: By Kumbha falling into the ocean, it got swollen to the form of Vindhya and Mandara mountain and water flowed all over.

40017636.author: पदार्थः
40017636.content: ततः then, कुम्भः Kumbha, समुत्पत्य rising up, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभिपद्य च hit him, क्रुद्धः in anger, वज्रवेगेन at thunderbolt speed, मुष्टिना with fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

40017636.author: Translation
40017636.content: Then Kumbha hit Sugriva in anger with his fist at the speed of a thunderbolt on his chest.

40017637.author: पदार्थः
40017637.content: तस्य his, चर्म च armour, पुस्फोट slit open, शोणितं blood, बहुसुस्राव flowed excessively, महावेगः at high speed, सःमुष्टिः his fist, अस्थिमण्डले skeletal framework, प्रतिजघ्ने in return struck.

40017637.author: Translation
40017637.content: The armour of Sugriva slit open, and blood flowed at high speed and excessively. The first hit of Kumbha hit the skeletal framework of Sugriva in return.

40017638.author: पदार्थः
40017638.content: तदा then, तत्र there, वेगेन speedily, महत् great, तेजः flame, मेरोःगिरेः Meru mountain, वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता force of the fist like thunderbolt, ज्वालायथा like flame, प्रज्वलितम् burst forth.

40017638.author: Translation
40017638.content: Then by the speed of the hit on Sugriva's chest by Kumbha's fist a flame burst forth like the flame of Meru Mountain.

40017639.author: पदार्थः
40017639.content: तत्र there, तेन by that, अभिहतः hit, महाबलः mighty, वानरर्षभः bull of Vanaras, सः he, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वज्रकल्पम् adamant, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched.

40017639.author: Translation
40017639.content: Then mighty Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, hit by the fist, clenched his fist adamantly.

40017640.author: पदार्थः
40017640.content: वीर्यवान् champion, सः he, अर्चिः Sun, चरविमण्डलसप्रभम् shone like disc encircled, मुष्टिम् fist, कुम्भस्य Kumbha's, उरसि chest, पातयामास pressed.

40017640.author: Translation
40017640.content: Sugriva, the champion pressed his first which shone like the Sun encircled with rays on the chest of Kumbha.

40017641.author: पदार्थः
40017641.content: सःकुम्भः that Kumbha, तेन by that, प्रहारेण blow, भृशताडितः pained severely, विह्वलः overcome with fear, तदा then, गतार्चिः glow gone, पावकःइव like fire, निपपात fell.

40017641.author: Translation
40017641.content: By the blow of Sugriva, that Kumbha was pained severely and overcome by fear he fell like fire which has lost its glow.

40017642.author: पदार्थः
40017642.content: तेन by that, मुष्टिना fist, अभिहतः struck, राक्षसः Rakshasa, दीप्तरमशिः glowing planet, लोहिताङ्गः endowed with brightness, यदृच्छया accidentally, आकाशादिव from the sky, आशु has, निपपात fallen.

40017642.author: Translation
40017642.content: Struck by the fist of Sugriva, the Rakshasa fell just as the glowing planet endowed with brightness accidentally fell from the sky.

40017643.author: पदार्थः
40017643.content: उरसि chest, मुष्टीना by fist, भग्नस्य broken, पततः fallen, कुम्भस्य Kumbhas, रूपम् form, रुद्राभिपन्नस्य over po were d by Rudra, गवांपतेः Lord of the sky, the Sun god, रूपंयथा like that form, बभौ shone.

40017643.author: Translation
40017643.content: Struck in the chest by Sugriva's fist, Kumbha fell down and shone like the Sun god over powered by Rudra।।
